snippet.title: The Legend of California - Official Playtest Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Playtest Gameplay Trailer for The Legend of California, the upcoming first-person open-world survival crafting game developed by Kintsugiyama. Players will set out to the elusive Island of California during the gold rush to seek out resources, dispatch enemies, and explore the wildlands alone or with friends in co-op. The Legend of California is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
